review.imagery: Seventeen project renders were visually reviewed. Sixteen native brochure scenes cover exterior, aerial, balcony/pool details, home interiors, two lobby angles, gym and spa. A distinct current-gallery gym angle is added. Prismatic backgrounds, generic people photographs and duplicate website crops are excluded. The complete tower exterior supplies the card and hero. Proposed interiors remain unit-unspecific. No dated construction photographs or card badges.
review.floorPlans: Three complete home drawings come from the official brochure. Three building sheets come from a Reelly-hosted mirror of the SAMANA-branded floorplate pack. They retain their exact floor groups and unit keys. Numerical unit areas and home-to-unit keys are absent. Confirm the approved unit, configuration and contractual area with SAMANA. All three official home sheets on physical pages 33–35 and all three mirror floorplates on pages 2–4 were visually reviewed. The full L-shaped footprint, first-floor gym and two recurring typical-floor groups remain visible. No numerical area is inferred from a generic category minimum, and no unverified three-bedroom drawing is invented.
review.location: Complete original brochure travel panel page 5 and regional map page 6 were visually reviewed. The Global Village, Dubai Mall and Miracle Garden source differences remain explicit. The official q value 25.09770283498989, 55.3797192146159 is saved with source hash and six-place rounding. No road distance, live route or precise entrance is inferred.
review.provenance: Fresh primary HTML and original official brochure retain receipts, original bytes and SHA-256 values. The supplementary pack is a Reelly-hosted broker-platform mirror, clearly distinguished from the official brochure. Native image origins, complete drawing sheets and physical PDF links remain available. Protected ownership and completed text research are preserved.

unavailable: Numerical drawing-specific home areas, approved home-to-unit applicability, a verified three-bedroom drawing, final fitout, a verified visitor entrance and dated construction photographs were not established.
